name: miniboard-fullstack-learning-demo
description: A learning-first Vue + Express + MySQL full-stack demo.

scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names API,WEB --prefix-colors blue,magenta "npm run dev -w @miniboard/server" "npm run dev -w @miniboard/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @miniboard/server && npm run build -w @miniboard/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @miniboard/server && npm run typecheck -w @miniboard/web
